stories.label: Iran war Day 7+: Hormuz closed, Europe drawn in, Trump says 4-5 weeks
stories.summary: Day 7: Hormuz officially closed by IRGC, 750 ships backed up. Spain blocks US bases — first NATO ally to break ranks. UK Cyprus base hit by Iranian missiles. Trump says 4-5 weeks, ground troops not ruled out. Congress to vote on war powers. Iran death toll 555+. Fourth US service member dead.

stories.label: Hormuz closed, global fleet trapped, oil and gas prices surging
stories.summary: IRGC declares Hormuz 'closed,' threatens to fire on any vessel. 750 ships backed up (100 container ships = 10% of global fleet). Fuel tanker ablaze from drone strike. Qatar LNG still halted. European gas doubled. AWS Dubai still down. 21% of daily global oil transits Hormuz.

stories.label: Khamenei killed: interim council active, succession race underway
stories.summary: Interim council (Arafi, president, chief justice) leading Iran. Assembly of Experts hasn't convened. Succession crisis ongoing amid active war. Hundreds of Iranians crossing into Turkey.

stories.label: Iran school strike: death toll 180+, total 555+ killed across 131 cities
stories.summary: Total Iran civilian death toll 555+ (Red Crescent). School strike toll 180+. 131 cities affected. CBC reports 153 dead at girls school. War crimes evidence mounting.

stories.label: Most Americans oppose Iran war — Congress to debate war powers
stories.summary: Only 25% of Americans approve strikes. Congress scheduled to vote on war powers motions this week. Republican majority expected to block. Democrats fracturing — anti-war candidates emerging.

stories.label: Lebanon bans Hezbollah military activities — Hezbollah rejects it
stories.summary: Lebanon's PM banned Hezbollah military activities. Hezbollah rejected it, says 'no justification.' Israel striking Lebanon after Hezbollah rocket fire. EU backs Lebanon's decision.

stories.label: Macron expands France's nuclear arsenal, offers nuclear aircraft to allies
stories.summary: France expanding nuclear arsenal and offering nuclear-armed aircraft to allies. Europe divided on Macron's offer. Driven by US distraction with Iran and wavering NATO credibility.

stories.label: Israel shuts Al-Aqsa during Ramadan under Iran war cover
stories.summary: Al-Aqsa Mosque closed during Ramadan. Combined with sealed Gaza crossings, settler violence. Iran war providing cover for intensified repression.

stories.label: El Niño may return in 2026, stacking warming on record temperatures
stories.summary: Forecasters warn El Niño may return in 2026. Would mean hottest period ever gets hotter. Consequences heaviest for Global South and Pacific islands.

stories.label: AWS data centers in Dubai destroyed by Iranian missiles
stories.summary: Iranian missiles set AWS Dubai data centers on fire. First time major cloud infrastructure physically destroyed by warfare. Services down across Middle East.

stories.label: 170 killed in South Sudan's Ruweng — MSF staff missing
stories.summary: ~170 killed in single attack in Ruweng, South Sudan. MSF staff missing. One of deadliest incidents in ongoing conflict.

stories.label: OpenAI takes Pentagon deal Anthropic rejected — Anthropic pays the price
stories.summary: OpenAI struck Pentagon deal Feb 28 for classified military AI. Anthropic rejected same demand — US Treasury now dropping Claude. AI reportedly used in Iran strikes regardless. The company that said no faces government retaliation.

stories.label: Prediction markets create 'depravity economy' betting on war deaths
stories.summary: Kalshi and Polymarket hosting active bets on Iran casualty counts, Hormuz closure, ground troops. Legal, CFTC-approved. Previous $1.2M insider trading suspected. War as tradeable commodity.

stories.label: Mass graves in eastern DRC — US now sanctions Rwanda's military
stories.summary: US sanctions Rwanda's army chief, defense chief, and two others — first significant Western military sanctions over DRC role. Follows mass graves found near Uvira. Rwanda hasn't responded.

stories.label: Nepal's first post-protest election March 5 — youth vs. old guard
stories.summary: Nepal votes March 5 after youth-led protests toppled K.P. Sharma Oli. New protest-born parties challenge CPN-UML and Nepali Congress. Tests whether street movements can convert to electoral power.

stories.label: India-Canada landmark nuclear energy deal resets frosty ties
stories.summary: Canada's PM Carney signs nuclear energy deal with India including uranium supply — dramatic reversal after Nijjar assassination fallout. Strategic amid Hormuz closure and energy market chaos.

stories.label: Fiji severe flooding — 100 roads closed, schools shut
stories.summary: Nearly 100 roads closed, schools shut for second day in Fiji's Western Division. Pacific island flooding amid El Niño warnings. Children playing in floodwaters.

stories.label: India's $60bn river storage plan threatens Pakistan's water supply
stories.summary: India investing $60bn in storage on rivers flowing into Pakistan. Indus Waters Treaty (1960) under strain. 200M+ downstream affected.

stories.label: Gaza sealed: crossings closed, Al-Aqsa shut, aid halted under Iran war cover
stories.summary: All crossings sealed. 37 aid orgs halted. Al-Aqsa shut during Ramadan. UN chief calling for reopening. Total siege under Iran war cover.

stories.label: Pakistan triple crisis: Iran protests, Afghan border war, IMF talks virtual
stories.summary: 23+ dead in pro-Iran protests. IMF talks gone virtual amid regional volatility. Afghanistan border war continuing. Three-way crisis.

stories.label: Ukraine-Russia war — peace talks status unclear, attention diverted
stories.summary: Urgently needs return to coverage. Peace talks status unclear. Russian strikes at 3-year peak. Iran war consuming all global attention and US military bandwidth.

stories.label: Sudan war — fading from global attention
stories.summary: Crisis continues. Iran war consuming all bandwidth. South Sudan massacre (170 killed, separate) adding to regional instability.

stories.label: Pre-solar crystals in meteorites reveal solar system's violent birth
stories.summary: One-off research finding. Crystals in meteorites predate the Sun. No follow-up expected.

stories.label: DNA reveals one-directional Neanderthal-human interbreeding pattern
stories.summary: One-off research finding. No follow-up expected.

stories.label: Selfish gene may bias sex ratio
stories.summary: One-off research finding. No follow-up expected.

stories.label: Data centers racing to space — beyond national jurisdiction
stories.summary: Companies launching data centers into orbit, beyond regulation. Connected to AWS Dubai destruction — physical vulnerability driving move to space.

stories.label: US intelligence shared Khamenei location with Israel
stories.summary: US disclosed Khamenei's location to Israel. May violate Executive Order 12333.

stories.label: Argentina: Milei pushes US 'strategic alliance' after labor reform
stories.summary: Labor reform passed. Milei pushing 'strategic alliance' with US.

stories.label: Kenya rolls out free HIV prevention injection
stories.summary: Lenacapavir twice-yearly injection, free of charge.

stories.label: Syria three-front crisis — attention pulled by Iran war
stories.summary: Syria fighting on three fronts. Iran war diverting attention.

stories.label: Zimbabwe bans all raw mineral and lithium exports
stories.summary: Ban on raw minerals and lithium exports. Africa's largest lithium reserves.

stories.label: Islamic State using AI to resurrect dead leaders
stories.summary: IS using generative AI for synthetic media of dead leaders.

stories.label: Pakistan-Afghanistan border war
stories.summary: Fighting continuing. No signs of de-escalation. Pakistan also dealing with pro-Iran protests and IMF pressure.
